evals.prompt: Package the final-v2 passers so collaborators can browse each design with all on-target and off-target refolds without SQLite.
evals.expected_output: A delivery TAR for final-v2 passers grouped by exact annotated input, containing each design, all linked aligned on/off-target refolds and available confidence JSON, actual criterion values in metrics.csv, and overall and per-input waterfall tables without excluded database or duplicate artifacts.
assertions: Groups designs by exact annotated-CIF input
Includes one design CIF and all linked aligned refolds with available confidence JSON
Writes actual criterion values in metrics.csv
Writes exact overall and per-input waterfall tables
Does not add a database, manifest, duplicate aligned design, oracle input copy, or alignment JSON
